name: Grand Hyatt Singapore
short_description: A 677-room Grand Hyatt on Scotts Road in Orchard, Singapore's shopping and entertainment district, with a Grand Club Lounge and multiple pools.
ai_summary: Grand Hyatt Singapore sits on Scotts Road, a few minutes' walk from Orchard MRT and the length of Orchard Road's shopping and dining strip. Guests consistently praise the hotel's cleanliness, spacious modern rooms, and attentive service, with the Terrace Wing's multiple pools and Mezza9's nine open-kitchen dining concepts drawing particular mention. It's a large, established property (677 rooms and suites, over 6,000 TripAdvisor reviews) rather than an intimate one, and some guests flag high prices and occasional nightclub noise as the trade-off for the central location.

elite_benefits: Grand Club Lounge access, including breakfast and evening cocktail presentations, for World of Hyatt Globalist Elite members
Room upgrades for Explorist and Globalist Elite members, subject to availability, per World of Hyatt program terms
Late check-out until 4pm for Globalist Elite members, subject to availability

pros: Central Orchard location, a few minutes' walk from Orchard MRT and the main shopping strip
Guests repeatedly praise cleanliness and spacious, modern rooms
Terrace Wing's multiple pools, spa/plunge pools, and Damai Spa
Mezza9's nine open-kitchen dining concepts (Thai, Japanese, grill, sustainable seafood, and more)
Grand Club Lounge available for suite guests, Club Access bookings, and Globalist Elite members
cons: Guests note prices are high relative to some other Orchard-area options
Some reviewers report occasional service inconsistency despite generally attentive staff
A few guests mention noise from the hotel's nightclub
research_highlights: Guests describe the hotel as immaculately clean with a prime, walkable Orchard Road location
Rooms are repeatedly called spacious, modern and luxurious
Mezza9 and the Terrace Wing pools are called out as standout amenities
research_watchouts: Some reviewers flag high prices relative to comparable Orchard Road hotels
A handful of reviews mention nightclub noise and occasional service inconsistency

faqs.question: How far is Grand Hyatt Singapore from Orchard MRT station?
faqs.answer: It's about a three-minute walk from Orchard MRT station, putting the hotel directly on Singapore's main shopping and entertainment strip with easy access to malls, restaurants, and public transit without needing a taxi for most errands.

faqs.question: Does Grand Hyatt Singapore have a club lounge?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the Grand Club Lounge offers check-in service, breakfast, and evening cocktail presentations. Access is included with suite bookings and Club Access packages, and is also a benefit for World of Hyatt Globalist Elite members.
